title: neurolepis stuebelii
intro: Neurolepis stuebelii, commonly known as Chilean Devil's Claw, is a plant species native to the Andes mountain range in South America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including relief from pain, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Neurolepis stuebelii are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and pain, as well as its effects on gut health and immune function. Bioactive constituents of this plant include harpagoside, a compound with anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, although more research is needed to confirm its full range of bioactive constituents.
